display.label: Azure Front Door (Classic)
display.description: Azure Front Door service providing global layer 7 load balancing, SSL offloading, and dynamic site acceleration

resource.key_description: The unique name for the Azure Front Door service. Serves as the map key.

fields.label: Front Door Name
fields.description: Specifies the name of the Front Door service. Must be globally unique, 5-64 characters.

validation.pattern_error: Front Door name must be between 5 and 64 characters, begin and end with an alphanumeric character, and contain only alphanumerics and hyphens.

fields.label: Resource Group Name
fields.description: Specifies the name of the Resource Group in which the Front Door service should exist.

fields.label: Friendly Name
fields.description: A friendly name for the Front Door service.

fields.label: Load Balancer Enabled
fields.description: Should the Front Door Load Balancer be enabled?

sections.label: Frontend Endpoints
sections.description: Frontend endpoints configuring the hostnames used to access the Front Door.

fields.label: Frontend Endpoints
fields.description: List of frontend hostnames configuring access to the Front Door.

fields.label: Endpoint Name
fields.description: The name of the frontend endpoint.

fields.label: Host Name
fields.description: The host name for the endpoint (e.g. my-app.azurefd.net or a verified custom domain).

fields.label: Session Affinity Enabled
fields.description: Whether session affinity (sticky sessions) is enabled for this endpoint.

fields.label: Session Affinity TTL (seconds)
fields.description: Session affinity TTL in seconds. Defaults to 0.

fields.label: WAF Policy Link ID
fields.description: The resource ID of the Web Application Firewall policy to associate.

sections.label: Backend Pools
sections.description: Backend pools that receive traffic from the Front Door.

fields.label: Backend Pools
fields.description: List of backend pools that receive traffic from the Front Door.

fields.label: Backend Pool Name
fields.description: The name of the backend pool.

fields.label: Load Balancing Settings Name
fields.description: The name of the backend_pool_load_balancing settings to use.

fields.label: Health Probe Settings Name
fields.description: The name of the backend_pool_health_probe settings to use.

fields.label: Backends
fields.description: List of backend targets for this pool.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Location to enable or disable traffic to this backend.

fields.label: Backend Address
fields.description: The IPv4 address or FQDN of the backend target.

fields.label: Host Header
fields.description: The value to use as the host header sent to the backend.

fields.label: HTTP Port
fields.description: The HTTP TCP port used to access backend.

fields.label: HTTPS Port
fields.description: The HTTPS TCP port used to access backend.

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: Priority to use for load balancing (1-5). Higher priorities are only used if lower priority backends are down.

fields.label: Weight
fields.description: Weight to use for load balancing (1-1000).

sections.label: Health Probes & Load Balancing
sections.description: Configuration for backend health checks and traffic distribution algorithms.

fields.label: Load Balancing Settings
fields.description: List of load balancing configuration blocks.

fields.label: Settings Name
fields.description: The name of the load balancing settings block.

fields.label: Sample Size
fields.description: The number of samples to consider for load balancing decisions.

fields.label: Successful Samples Required
fields.description: The number of samples within the sample size that must succeed.

fields.label: Additional Latency Sensitivity (ms)
fields.description: The additional latency tolerance in milliseconds for routing to acceptable backends.

fields.label: Health Probe Settings
fields.description: List of health probe configuration blocks.

fields.label: Probe Name
fields.description: The name of the health probe settings block.

fields.label: Probe Enabled
fields.description: Whether this health probe is enabled.

fields.label: Probe Path
fields.description: The path relative to the host used to probe backend health.

fields.label: Probe Protocol
fields.description: The protocol scheme used for the health probe.

fields.label: Probe Method
fields.description: The HTTP method used for the health probe.

fields.label: Interval (seconds)
fields.description: The number of seconds between health probes.

sections.label: Routing Rules
sections.description: Routing rules connecting frontend endpoints to backend pools or redirecting traffic.

fields.label: Routing Rules
fields.description: List of routing rules connecting frontend endpoints to backend pools or redirecting traffic.

fields.label: Routing Rule Name
fields.description: The name of the routing rule.

fields.label: Accepted Protocols
fields.description: Protocol schemes to accept for this routing rule.

fields.label: Patterns to Match
fields.description: Route matching path patterns.

fields.label: Frontend Endpoints
fields.description: List of frontend endpoint names to associate with this rule.

fields.label: Forwarding Configuration
fields.description: Routing destination backend pool and forwarding settings.

fields.label: Backend Pool Name
fields.description: The name of the backend pool to forward traffic to.

fields.label: Forwarding Protocol
fields.description: Protocol to use when redirecting traffic to backends.

fields.label: Enable Caching
fields.description: Whether to enable caching for this route.

fields.label: Dynamic Compression
fields.description: Whether to use dynamic compression for cached content.

fields.label: Query Parameter Strip Directive
fields.description: Treatment of URL query strings when generating cache keys.

fields.label: Cache Query Parameters
fields.description: Query parameters used for caching according to strip directive.

fields.label: Cache Duration
fields.description: Duration to cache content in ISO 8601 format (e.g. P1DT12H).

fields.label: Custom Forwarding Path
fields.description: Path to rewrite before forwarding to the backend.

fields.label: Redirect Configuration
fields.description: Redirection configuration for this routing rule.

fields.label: Custom Host
fields.description: Host to redirect to. If not set, the request host is used.

fields.label: Redirect Type
fields.description: The redirect type for the rule.

fields.label: Redirect Protocol
fields.description: Protocol to use for redirect.

fields.label: Custom Path
fields.description: The path to retain or replace for the redirect.

fields.label: Custom Fragment
fields.description: The fragment to add to the redirect URL.

fields.label: Custom Query String
fields.description: The query string to add to the redirect URL.

sections.label: Tags
sections.description: Key-value pairs to categorize and organize Front Door resources.

fields.label: Resource Tags
fields.description: A mapping of tags to assign to the Front Door resource.
